build_system: npm scripts (two separate packages: root + web-ui)
content_formats: Gherkin (.feature) — BDD scenario files consumed by Cucumber.js
JSON (step-catalog.json) — machine-generated step registry, source of truth for web-ui catalog
JSON (step-enums.json) — hand-curated paramEnum values, writable by web-ui PUT /api/enums
NDJSON (cucumber-messages.ndjson) — Cucumber dry-run output consumed by extract-steps.ts
Markdown (STEP_CATALOG.md) — human-readable catalog, generated by render-markdown.ts
EJS — not used; import-scenarios.ts uses plain string templates
